title: ETS 03 — Booking & Redis Pressure
description: 排查 Booking 熱路徑與 Redis 閘道壓力 (Booking hot-path and Redis gate health). Use when booking error rate or booking P99 latency rises above baseline. Row 1 shows which booking stage is slow or failing: preadmission (Redis gate) → idempotency_lock → event_lock → capacity → commit. Row 2 shows Redis gate health: reserve latency spike with outage_mode=degrade means Redis is slow but bookings continue degraded; outage_mode=fail means Redis is actively rejecting bookings. Row 3 shows capacity outcomes: rising 'exhausted' is a legitimate capacity hit, not a bug. Row 4 shows rate limiting: actor-scoped drops mean a specific user is hammering bookings.

panels.title: ▶ BOOKING STAGES — Which stage in the booking hot-path is slow or failing?
Booking Stage P95 Latency
panels.description: P95 latency per booking stage. Stages in order: preadmission (Redis gate) → begin_tx → idempotency_lock → event_lock → validate → duplicate_lookup → capacity → create_response → commit. The slowest stage is the bottleneck. If 'preadmission' is slow, check Redis gate panels below. If 'commit' is slow, check DB pool/lock.

panels.title: Booking Stage Error Rate by Stage
panels.description: Rate of booking stage observations with outcome=error per stage. A rise on 'capacity' means event is full or Redis gate erroring. A rise on 'commit' means a DB transaction is failing. Jump to Service Anomaly and find a trace for the failing stage.

panels.title: ▶ REDIS GATE — Is Redis the cause? Reserve/commit latency and outage mode.
Pre-Admission P95 by Operation × Outage Mode
panels.description: P95 latency for Redis gate operations (reserve/release/commit), labelled by outage_mode. outage_mode=none means Redis is healthy. outage_mode=degrade means Redis is slow but the booking continues. outage_mode=fail means Redis returned an error and the booking was rejected.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (outcome, outage_mode, capacity_type, le) (rate(cets_booking_preadmission_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Reservation Attempt Outcomes
panels.description: Rate of reservation gate outcomes. 'confirmed' = pre-admission granted. 'waitlisted' = over capacity, put on waitlist. 'exhausted' = event full. 'error' = Redis error. A spike in 'error' with outage_mode=fail means Redis is the culprit for booking failures.

panels.title: ▶ RATE LIMITING — Is booking being throttled?
Rate Limit Drop Rate by Scope
panels.description: Rate of booking requests dropped by the rate limiter. scope=actor means a specific employee is being throttled (per-employee-per-event limit). scope=event means global event booking rate is being capped. High actor drops suggest a retry storm from one client. High event drops suggest the event is extremely popular.

panels.title: Pre-Admission by Capacity Type
panels.description: Pre-admission outcomes split by capacity_type. 'limited' events have a fixed seat count and will exhaust. 'unlimited' events bypass capacity checks. If 'limited' exhausted rate is rising, the event is sold out — not a bug. If 'unlimited' events are erroring, there is a Redis or DB issue.

panels.title: ▶ COMPENSATION — Are failed/expired reservations being cleaned up?
Reservation Compensation Actions
panels.description: Rate of reservation compensation sweep actions. 'released' = expired reservation cleaned up successfully. 'missing_pending' = reservation row not found. 'error' = compensation failed. High 'error' rate means stale reservations are accumulating and seat capacity may appear consumed when it should be free.

panels.title: Reservation Counter Drift Guard
panels.description: Results of the drift-guard pass that corrects Redis counter divergence from PostgreSQL. 'unchanged' = counters match. 'capped' = Redis was overcounting and was corrected. 'no_counter' = event not found in Redis. Persistent 'capped' results mean Redis is diverging from Postgres truth.

panels.title: Redis Operation Rate by Operation × Result
panels.description: Rate of individual Redis Lua script calls (reserve, commit, release). Rising 'error' or 'timeout' results indicate Redis health degradation at the operation level.

panels.title: Redis Operation P95 Latency by Operation
panels.description: P95 latency of each Redis script call type. Spikes here directly explain booking preadmission latency. Normal: <20ms. Warning: >50ms. Critical: >150ms (operation timeout).
